answer_1.quote: Our experiments on information asymmetry tasks (e.g., QA with unshared resources) and information symmetry tasks (e.g., debates and agent workflows) show that SDE can significantly improve the performance of multi‑agent systems.

answer_2.quote: We report the average exact match (EM) scores and F1 scores in Quasar‑T and ComplexWebQuestions tasks and the average accuracy in StrategyQA tasks.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate our approach by comparing it with baseline communication protocols using standard automatic metrics; no LLM is employed as a post‑generation judge.
